*Updated February 20, 2011* 

Listed below are all players who earned Grand Prix byes based on their Competitive Planeswalker Points for the timeframe of August 29, 2011 to December 25, 2011. This list is a composite of Competitive Planeswalker Points earned including World Championships/**Magic** Weekend San Francisco and excluding that event. These byes apply only to Grand Prix run from December 26, 2011 - April 1, 2012.
